name: ErrorPage
intent: Full-page error state for route-level failures and access errors (404 / 401 / 403 / 500 / 503 or a generic fallback), centered in the viewport with a recovery action.
when: A route failed to load, was not found, or the user lacks access
A server/service error needs a whole-page state with a way out
Pre-auth or boot-time failures shown before the app shell mounts
whenNot: An inline, recoverable error inside otherwise-valid content -> use Alert
A populated page that simply has no data/results -> use Empty
A transient, auto-dismissing failure message -> use Sonner (toast)

chooseOver.because: Empty is a zero-data placeholder inside a working page; ErrorPage is a whole-page failure state (something went wrong, not just nothing here).
Alert is an inline/section message that keeps the surrounding page usable; ErrorPage takes over the full page.

regions.note: Hidden when showCode=false; the title becomes the lead for non-status errors.
Typically a primary 'Go home' / 'Retry' / 'Sign in' Button; rendered below the description.

requiredComponents.name: Button
requiredComponents.note: Recovery action. Wrap a router Link with <Button asChild> for navigation — do not navigate via onClick.

dataContract.note: Stateless and config-driven — no data source, no fetching, no async loading/error lifecycle (the page IS the error state). Content comes from the `type` preset or explicit prop overrides; see configSchema.

type.note: Selects a preset code + title + description.

showCode.note: Set false for non-HTTP/generic errors so a meaningless code number is not shown.

action.note: Recovery action region (usually a Button). `children` is also rendered after the action.

states.default: Generic error ('Error' / 'Something Went Wrong') centered in a min-h-[400px] column.
states.preset: type=404|401|403|500|503 renders the matching code, title, and description.
states.with-action: An `action` (e.g. a Button) renders below the description for recovery.
states.no-code: showCode=false hides the large status number; the title leads.
states.custom: Compound components (ErrorPageCode/Title/Description/Action) or children fully override the preset content.

forbiddenPlacement: inline within a populated section (use Alert)

commonMistakes.mistake: Using ErrorPage for an inline, recoverable section error
commonMistakes.symptom: A whole-page block interrupts otherwise-valid content
commonMistakes.fix: Use Alert for inline/section errors that keep the page usable.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using ErrorPage for an empty data state (no results)
commonMistakes.symptom: Reads as a failure when nothing actually failed
commonMistakes.fix: Use Empty for zero-data inside a populated page.

commonMistakes.mistake: Navigating via onClick on the action Button
commonMistakes.symptom: Breaks middle-click / open-in-new-tab; no real href
commonMistakes.fix: Wrap a router Link with <Button asChild> for navigation.

commonMistakes.mistake: Mixing a `type` preset with contradictory explicit code/title
commonMistakes.fix: Either pick a preset via `type`, or override code+title+description together — not a contradictory mix.

commonMistakes.mistake: Leaving showCode=true for a generic, non-status error
commonMistakes.symptom: A meaningless 'Error' number dominates the page

evaluationCriteria.check: ErrorPage chosen for route/full-page failures — not Alert (inline) or Empty (no-data).
Either a valid `type` preset is used, or code+title+description are all provided; no contradictory mix.
A recovery action (Button navigating via asChild Link) is provided for 404/403/401.
Title and description regions render; the code region is present unless showCode=false.
